answer: Proposal: a finite, externally audited walnut registry grants each issuer one reward stream; its basalt bond backs one signed delegation to a child for 30 epochs. Validators pay a child only by debiting that issuer’s oasis pool; conflicting delegations forfeit the bond. A farm can rent issuer rights and share a model, but each added clone consumes one existing 30-epoch slot and its entire prior payout, not new issuance. Borrowing rights buys that stream rather than multiplying it. Without a registered sponsor the clone earns zero; onboarding is permissioned.
